notes.title: Alpha 2a Bugfixes Release
notes.content:
New Feature: Global leaderboards around view, shows what rank you are when you are not in the top 10 including two spots above and below you.

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] No audio on load
[*] Laser pointer stops working after hitting the Steam button
[*] Menu button stop working
[*] Tweaks to the Space Track colliders to close up holes that allowed you to escape (This will also reset the leaderboards for the Space Track)
[/list]

We also have a public trello page where you can suggest new ideas and vote on current ones. https://trello.com/b/i6tYoda2

notes.title: Known Issues
notes.content:
We are working to fix a few known issues, hopefully we can get an updated pushed later today

[list]
[*] No sound - Sometimes the volume sliders default to 0. If you don't have any sound, go into settings and set the volume sliders to your preferred levels.
[*] Pointer not working on menus - After you hit the steam button, the menu buttons will no longer work until you restart Grapply
[*] Glitches in Space Track -  There are a few points where you can escape the track and a few other places where you can get stuck on the sides. We will reset the leaderboards after it gets fix to make it fair.
[/list]
